For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

What will your responsibilities be?

• You will be responsible for corrective, preventive and improvement-oriented maintenance of the machinery, equipment and buildings. 
• You will carry out scheduled maintenance and perform the necessary repairs. 
• You will ensure the production machinery operates optimal.

Who are you?

• You are able to identify and resolve technical faults. 
• You have a good command of either Dutch or English.

Looking for an international environment? Do you possess strong B2B communication skills? Then this technical support role within the medical device sector is looking for you! Here in Machelen, you will be handling incoming communication from internal and external stakeholders and be responsible for:

• Following strict internal guidelines to ensure a high level of reporting quality for medical matters.
• Processing and updating projects in SAP.
• Monitoring POs and shipments.
• Escalating more complex problems to the specific departments, which could be regarding accounting or more technical issues. It depends on the problem!
• Logging and archiving of reports and contracts.
• Backup for other administrative tasks.
 

• You communicate fluently in English AND Italian or Spanish.
• In possession of a university degree and a Belgian working permit
• Experience within larger company structures is a plus.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you!

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?
Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you interested in a job as Powder Coater? And are you ready for a quick start? Then read further!
For a company located in Wingene, we are looking for a Powder Coater!

What are your tasks?

• Prepare and cleane the metal parts
• Hang or position items that need to be coated
• Apply the powder coating by spraying
• Perform quality checks 
• Operate the curing oven
Hours: day hours Monday to Friday, often working on Saturdays

Who are you?

• You have experience in production, preferably as powder coater or within a company of sorts
• You speak English or Polish 
• You have your own transportation
• You are available quickly

For our client, a company in the Ghent region that operates in the steel industry, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Overhead Crane Operator.

Your tasks: 

• You will be responsible for lifting and moving steel plates using the overhead crane.
• You will work independently.
• You must not be afraid of heights and must have good depth perception.
• You have to load the trucks with metal parts.
• Correctly positioning the metal coils in the warehouse. 
Who are you?
• You speak English well
• You live within a 30-km radius of Evergem and have your own transport. 
• You enjoy working independently and do so effectively, are not afraid of heights, and have good depth perception.
• You are a hard worker.
• Experience as a crane operator.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Location: Kluisbergen
Industry: Rubber Manufacturing
Work Schedule: 2 shifts (early & late)
About the Company
We are a well-established rubber manufacturing company based in Kluisbergen, specialized in the production of high-quality rubber products for various industrial applications. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a motivated Production Operator to strengthen our team.
Your Responsibilities
• 
Operating and monitoring production machines

• 
Setting up machines according to production parameters

• 
Performing quality checks on finished products

• 
Identifying and reporting technical or production issues

• 
Ensuring a safe, clean, and organized working environment

• 
Working closely with colleagues and supervisors to meet production targets

• 
You have first experience as an operator in a production environment

• 
Technical insight and willingness to learn

• 
Ability to work accurately and independently

• 
Good understanding of safety and quality standards

• 
You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system

• 
Good knowledge of English (Dutch is a plus)

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds
• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds
• Providing general technical support
• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential
• Able to work very precisely and neatly
• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage
• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools
• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team
• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement
• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed
• Positive, constructive attitude
• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English

Ready to take charge of your own CNC machine and produce high-quality parts?

Your Responsibilities:

• Work on a fixed machine and fully utilize your expertise

• Experience with overhead cranes or willingness to learn

• Able to program and set up machines independently
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French, or English
• Experience as a CNC milling operator or machinist

For our client located in Bredene, we are looking for a CNC TURNER.

As a CNC TURNER in the Bredene region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • You will sometimes produce small series of parts, while other times you will make unique, customer-specific pieces;
  • You will work on a wide range of components, from large rollers and large-diameter parts to wear sleeves for pumps and parts for combine harvesters;
  • You will start with smaller pieces and gradually grow into working on larger components;
  • To work efficiently, you can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You manufacture unique parts based on technical drawings, with little repetitive series work;
  • You accurately measure and check finished products.
As a CNC TURNER in the BREDENE region, you can identify with the following:

  • You have experience as a conventional turner, milling machine operator or CNC turner? Great, we are looking for you!
  • We have approximately 25 machines. You will not have a fixed workstation but will learn to operate almost all of them. You will start on a standard lathe and gradually develop your skills;
  • You can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!
